matched.uncertainty: One group/session per dataset and arm; descriptive only; no confidence intervals or significance.
matched.payback_scope: Observed policy-level cumulative latency savings include all online overhead but are not causal per-migration execution payback. Matched branch diagnostics must separately establish comparable predecision state and future work.

allow_migrations.scope: GPU-copy durations may overlap across ranks; not additive wall-time cost. Proposal-to-commit includes background waiting. Unobserved commits censored; drain is not commit proof.

skip_migrations.scope: GPU-copy durations may overlap across ranks; not additive wall-time cost. Proposal-to-commit includes background waiting. Unobserved commits censored; drain is not commit proof.

limitations: Separate restarted full-model sessions, no cloned/full-hashed KV state.
Map, demand and completed-prefix agreement are necessary diagnostics, not proof of identical active-request state.
Different generated outputs/routes can change work despite exact lengths.
If the target is absent, candidate is unchanged or states disagree, migration-specific payback is inconclusive.
Only one ordered allow/skip pair; timing drift unestimated. Net execution contrast is descriptive, not isolated transfer cost.
